title: neotinea tridentata
intro: Neotinea tridentata, commonly known as the Autumn Gentian, is a flowering plant species in the orchid family, characterized by its vibrant purple flowers. The health benefits of Neotinea tridentata include its potential in treating fever and inflammation, and it has been traditionally used to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and the specific actions of its bioactive constituents.
